items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Stop laughing Luis. People will be more productive. I got him on that. You can laugh.

ctx.x: Well here’s the interesting thing about all that with musicians. We’ve been doing that for years, sort of taking responsibility for our own things. Well I’m sorry to say that it’s happening more to everyone, and as companies come up with more catch phrases like “downsizing” and “outsizing,” you know, companies are coming in these days — I was supposed to go to Japan in June with the Eastman Wind Ensemble, sponsored by Kodak. But Kodak couldn’t do that because they had to lay off twelve hundred employees. Okay,…
productive. Stop laughing Luis. People will be more productive. I got him on that. You can laugh.
You’re a fan and supporter of technology.
